articles.summary: The Duke Energy Foundation is committing $1 million to support nonprofits across North Carolina that deliver critical community services, including housing stability, food access, health care, utility assistance and more.
articles.title: Duke Energy commits $1 million to strengthen nonprofits helping North Carolina customers meet essential needs

articles.summary: Duke Energy will post its first-quarter 2026 financial results at 7 a.m. ET on Tuesday, May 5, on the company’s website at duke-energy.com/investors.
articles.title: Duke Energy to announce first-quarter 2026 financial results on May 5

articles.summary: On April 18, Duke Energy recognizes National Lineworker Appreciation Day and the lineworkers who keep the lights on across South Carolina. From year-round grid work that improves reliability to storm response, lineworkers bring skill, teamwork and a strong safety focus to the work customers depend on. To help grow the workforce in the Palmetto State, Duke Energy Foundation is granting $75,000 to programs in South Carolina that train tomorrow’s lineworkers.
articles.title: Duke Energy honors South Carolina lineworkers who help restore power and build the energy grid of the future

articles.summary: Duke Energy has filed requests with the North Carolina Utilities Commission (NCUC) related to fuel and purchased power costs incurred during one of the most extreme winter periods in the past decade – costs driven by record customer energy demand resulting from the cold weather and the utility’s commitment to keep power available and reliable when it is needed most.
articles.title: Duke Energy outlines steps to reliably serve record customer demand resulting from extreme winter weather

articles.summary: April is National Safe Digging Month, and Duke Energy and Piedmont Natural Gas are recognizing the importance of calling 811 before starting any digging projects.
articles.title: Ready to dig? Duke Energy, Piedmont Natural Gas remind residents to call 811 before beginning spring digging projects

articles.summary: In 2025, self-healing technology helped avoid 100,000 outages for Indiana customers, saving around 350,000 hours of total outage time.
articles.title: It’s storm season in Indiana: Duke Energy’s investments in smart, self-healing technology are helping keep the lights on

articles.summary: Located in Hartsville, S.C., Robinson provides enough energy to power 570,000 homes and plays an important role in protecting reliability and affordability for customers as regional electricity demand continues to grow.
articles.title: Robinson Nuclear Plant receives approval from U.S. Nuclear Regulatory Commission to continue operating until 2050

articles.summary: Duke Energy marks Opening Day of the Tampa Bay Rays baseball season with additional commitments to Floridians. The company and its foundation will donate $1,000 to its Share the Light Fund for every Rays regular-season game win, providing financial support to Florida customers.
articles.title: On Tampa Bay Rays Opening Day, Duke Energy Pledges Funds for Florida Customers Facing Financial Hardships Throughout the 2026 Baseball Season

articles.summary: South Carolina customers are projected to benefit from billions of dollars in savings over time after the Public Service Commission of South Carolina approved a settlement on Duke Energy’s proposed combination of Duke Energy Carolinas and Duke Energy Progress, an agreement designed to deliver measurable, trackable customer savings backed by shareholder guarantees.
articles.title: South Carolina customers projected to benefit from billions in long-term savings from approved combination of Duke Energy utilities

articles.title: Beyond Storm Response: Lineworkers making the system upgrades customers depend on

articles.summary: To strengthen communities across South Carolina as the nation approaches its 250th anniversary, Duke Energy Foundation is awarding $275,000 to organizations through a first round of funding as part of its America250 initiative. The grants – part of a total investment of more than $550,000 in the Palmetto State – will help revitalize parks and shared green spaces, support tree planting, trail maintenance and litter prevention.
articles.title: Duke Energy Foundation announces first round of America250 grants to strengthen and protect South Carolina green spaces

articles.summary: This initial grantmaking reflects the Duke Energy Foundation’s broader America250 commitment, with additional investments in veterans’ workforce development and civics education to follow later this spring.
articles.title: Ahead of Earth Day, Duke Energy Foundation announces first round of America250 grants to revitalize local parks and green spaces

articles.summary: Duke Energy Florida recently hosted its Neighborhood Energy Saver Program in Clearwater. While over 2,200 local customers are eligible to participate, approximately 75 attended the event, held at the Ross Norton Recreation Center, to learn how they can receive a free walkthrough energy assessment of their homes and help lower their monthly electricity bills.
articles.title: Duke Energy Florida hosts Neighborhood Energy Saver Program in Clearwater

articles.title: Energy field trip opens young eyes to the power of science

articles.summary: Duke Energy lineworkers from across the Carolinas advanced from a regional rodeo over the weekend to represent the company at the International Lineman’s Rodeo in October in Bonner Springs, Kan., where they will compete against top lineworkers from around the world.
